lineage_context.teaching_goal: Use the Ribes shrub habit, lobed leaves, hypanthium/inferior ovary and berry fruit to define the family.

project_scope.note: Grossulariaceae is monogeneric under current Kew, restricted to Ribes.

family_diagnostics.where_to_look_first: Look for an alternate-leaved shrub with palmately lobed leaves and small flowers in racemes. Confirm an inferior 2-carpellate ovary inside a hypanthium and a few- to many-seeded berry crowned by persistent floral remnants.
family_diagnostics.vegetative: Shrubs; leaves alternate, simple, usually palmately 3–5-lobed, often glandular or aromatic; stipules small or sometimes absent on older shoots.
family_diagnostics.reproductive: Flowers small, often in racemes; hypanthium conspicuous; usually 5 sepals and 5 small petals; stamens usually 5; ovary inferior, 2-carpellate, with 2 styles.
family_diagnostics.fruit: A berry, often retaining dried flower parts at its apex.
family_diagnostics.field_tip: Lobed alternate Ribes shrub + hypanthium + inferior ovary + berry = Grossulariaceae.

visual_lesson.teaching_order: lobed alternate leaf → raceme → hypanthium/inferior ovary → 2 styles → berry → close-family comparison
visual_lesson.intro: Ribes is the berry-producing woody branch of this Saxifragales batch.

steps.title: 1 · Start with the lobed alternate leaf
steps.look_for: Palmately lobed leaf on an alternate twig, often with a somewhat rounded outline.
steps.why_it_matters: This creates the currant/gooseberry gestalt before flowers appear.

steps.title: 2 · Look into the hypanthium
steps.look_for: The floral cup surrounds the inferior ovary; sepals and tiny petals sit above it.
steps.why_it_matters: Ovary position is the key family-level reproductive clue.

steps.title: 3 · Find the two styles
steps.look_for: Two style branches associated with the 2-carpellate inferior ovary.
steps.why_it_matters: Reinforces the family gynoecium rather than relying only on berry color.

steps.title: 4 · Follow it to a berry
steps.look_for: Fleshy berry with persistent floral remnants at the top.
steps.why_it_matters: Fruit makes the family easy to distinguish from dry-fruited Saxifragales relatives.

comparisons.title: Grossulariaceae vs Rosaceae
comparisons.rule: Some Ribes can resemble small lobed-leaved rosaceous shrubs, but Ribes has an inferior ovary and berry; many Rosaceae have superior/perigynous ovaries and very different fruit architectures.

comparisons.title: Grossulariaceae vs Hydrangeaceae
comparisons.rule: Both can have inferior ovaries, but Ribes has alternate lobed leaves and berries; project Hydrangeaceae has opposite leaves and dry capsules.

visual_lesson.caveat: Spines are not universal across Ribes. Use leaf arrangement, flower/ovary structure and berry fruit.

genera.fast_cue: alternate lobed shrub + small raceme flowers + inferior ovary/hypanthium + berry

visual_targets.annotation_goal: label hypanthium, ovary, sepals and petals
